purpose: Authoritative inventory of full production guides supplied by the TFPM owner.

facts: TFPM's owner-supplied guide collection currently includes six verified commercial tree-fruit guides covering the Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, New Jersey, Michigan, Washington, and the Pacific Northwest.

The six guides are: 2026 Spray Bulletin for Commercial Tree Fruit Growers; 2026 Southeastern Peach, Nectarine, and Plum Pest Management and Culture Guide; 2026 Integrated Orchard Management Guide for Commercial Apples in the Southeast; 2025/2026 New Jersey Commercial Tree Fruit Production Guide; Washington State University's Integrated Fruit Production Guide; and Michigan Fruit Management Guide 2026.
A guide being present in the catalog does not mean every page has already been converted into searchable facts.
The Michigan guide has partial topic-level indexing. The other five guides are cataloged and awaiting topic-by-topic extraction.
Source names are provided when the user asks for them; ordinary grower answers present the information without citations.

sources.title: 2026 Spray Bulletin for Commercial Tree Fruit Growers
sources.notes: Multi-institution regional bulletin. Preserve state, edition, crop, and label context.

sources.title: 2026 Southeastern Peach, Nectarine, and Plum Pest Management and Culture Guide
sources.notes: Multi-state guide with disease, insect, weed, vertebrate, cultural, safety, and pesticide information. Preserve regional, edition, crop, and label context.

sources.title: 2026 Integrated Orchard Management Guide for Commercial Apples in the Southeast
sources.notes: Integrated orchard-management guide. Preserve regional, edition, crop, and label context.

sources.organization: Rutgers New Jersey Agricultural Experiment Station
sources.title: 2025/2026 New Jersey Commercial Tree Fruit Production Guide
sources.notes: Includes production, horticulture, pest, disease, weed, nutrition, frost, safety, and application information. Preserve New Jersey, edition, crop, and label context.

sources.title: Integrated Fruit Production Guide
sources.notes: Live section-based guide rather than a single annual PDF. Retain page access/update date and Washington-specific pesticide context.

sources.title: Michigan Fruit Management Guide 2026
sources.notes: Revised annually. Pesticide information never supersedes the product label.
